items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I think he had a piano player with him by the name of Dave Lewenta. He was from, I forget where he was from, but he was a fine piano player.

ctx.x: What about Perranti? Did you go around and listen to his band ever?

Perranti, yes. I can remember Perranti when he played at the Liberty Theater. He was a big man in those days. All the women and all the girls and everybody used to be running behind him, because he was really a real handsome looking guy, and played fine clarinet in those days. And I believe Perranti had a band at the La Vida, didn't he, at one time? That was right next door to the Fern Dance Hall. And we used to listen, we used to go next door, whenever we got somebody to sit in and play for us at the point, and…
